dialogues.speaker: Helmut
dialogues.text: Haha, the threat of the Wild Hunt is finally over and done! Time to kick back and celebrate. How long has it been since we last had a drink here in Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Arved
dialogues.text: You shouldn't drink too much, Helmut. Captain Frederica always says that we Knight of Favonius must stay vigilant and true to our duties at all times—

dialogues.speaker: Helmut
dialogues.text: Ah, come on! The Master of the Wild Hunt has already been taken care of, and some elements of Fifth Company have even been sent back to Mondstadt. Our duty now is to drink and celebrate!

dialogues.speaker: Silja
dialogues.text: Mmm... the Fifth Company? They're kind of the exception to the rule, aren't they? Considering Vice-Captain Lohen's style and how intense their last missions were, skipping a proper rest in Mondstadt would actually be worrying.

dialogues.speaker: Helmut
dialogues.text: But think about it — Cardinal Seamus went back too! Although that's because—

dialogues.speaker: Arved
dialogues.text: ...Talking about other people's private matters so freely is a straight shot to getting yourself kicked by a horse, Helmut.

dialogues.speaker: Helmut
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, enough talking. Let's drink! Oi! ten more mugs of mead — and make 'em large!
